payload.title: Run production ClayCode atomic CAS/ABA differential on Ubuntu
payload.work_clay: After the current strict-LALR baseline is reconstructable, implement the minimum canonical-IR/typechecker/runtime contract for atomic compare-exchange: stable semantic op/cell identity, explicit success/failure ordering, value-only versus version/epoch-bound identity mode, semantic outcome separated from physical retry attempts. Lower and execute the frozen ABA/retry/counter corpus through the production ClayCode toolchain on Andreas' Ubuntu developer host and at least one second backend when available.
payload.reason_clay: Hosted executable research falsified value-only CAS as a universal identity guard: 200000/200000 constructed ABA histories stale-accepted with value-only comparison while version-bound comparison stale-accepted 0/200000. C11 and ECMAScript CAS counters reached identical exact semantic totals despite different physical retry counts. Production ClayCode and target-host evidence is still missing.
payload.completion_clay: Record source/IR/compiler/backend hashes; parser/typechecker acceptance and invalid-order rejection; deterministic ABA corpus with raw stale accepts and version-bound stale rejects; weak-CAS retry perturbation proving semantic hash stability and execution-trace sensitivity; cross-backend exact counter semantics; capability/effect authority unchanged; Ubuntu target receipt; every mismatch explained; no BASE PASS unless the existing acceptance gate is independently satisfied.
payload.executor_policy: Prefer local Claude Code/build organ with repository checkout and Andreas Ubuntu developer-host access. Preserve the live strict-LALR worker; do not race-edit its grammar. Do not infer PASS from hosted proxy evidence.
invalidators: production ClayCode concurrency/atomic contract is superseded before execution
target state model proves value equality is stable identity for all tested CAS cells
